title: Love the concept and excellent support
body:
Facing some issues with the app, I contacted the support and almost immediately I received a response. Hands on the problem coming up with updates to fix bugs etc. So support 10/10!

The app itself is also great. I love how it implements fun to let kids to their tasks. Both my kids have autism and I tried many things, but this really has their interest. The “game” also grows with their progress which is awesome as it keeps being interesting. Kids love it and it has never been so easy to let them get their chores done.
Thus, concept 10/10!
author: SarrahR

title: Best app ever
body: I have 2 boys, both with ADHD! Joon saved my life! I created more than 47 daily quests because they need everything to be detailed and clear, and most of them are done with happiness! Thank you so much 🙏🏻
